title: End-of-Sale & End-of-Life Notice for Zscaler Shift

blocks.text: Zscaler is announcing the End-of-Sale (EOS) and End-of-Life (EOL) dates for Zscaler Shift (also known as Zscaler Intelligent Routing for Guest Wi-Fi Protection). Shift is an easy-to-use cloud service that provides carrier-grade security and compliance for your organization's network.

As of November 1, 2022, Intelligent Routing Guest Wi-Fi SKUs are no longer available for purchase. Existing contracts will not be renewed beyond the EOL date. Existing deployments of Shift will be supported until the EOL date.
If you are using Shift, you should consider a migration plan to Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA)—the world's largest security-as-a-service (SaaS) cloud platform.
Contact Zscaler Support to devise a migration plan.
If you have additional questions, contact Zscaler Support.
